author: RohanArun
text:
@Super_Powers_AI Hey Super, build a high-precision enterprise workload architecture tool and capacity planner for deploying Astra in Microsoft Foundry on Azure.
https://t.co/QOLd5yFbmV

Grounded in the announcement by Satya Nadella and Sam Altman regarding early customer access, the application must feature an interactive first-viewport canvas and topology designer where architects configure real-world enterprise agent workflows—specifying user concurrency, prompt context token volume, generation lengths, context caching efficiency, and Azure grounding connectors such as Azure AI Search index integration. The simulator must immediately calculate and render a visual pipeline latency waterfall spanning prefill time, grounding lookup, and decode tokens per second alongside provisioned throughput unit cluster recommendations, monthly commitment economics, and peak SLA headroom.

The interface must provide pre-configured enterprise scenario archetypes—including High-Throughput Customer Support Agent, Complex Document Synthesis, and Real-Time Legal Analysis—that instantly mutate the topology canvas and telemetry metrics, recalculating exact mathematical latency percentiles and bandwidth requirements while highlighting bottleneck warnings when token rates exceed provisioned boundaries. Furthermore, provide direct JSON and tabular architecture exports packaging the complete sizing manifest, token budgets, and configuration guidelines for Azure Foundry provisioning, executed in a crisp, authoritative light enterprise aesthetic using high-legibility typography, clear system diagrams, and zero placeholder data.
